about: A wipe's payout file as a game writes it (meter/gamepay.py header): `<world>.payout-<wipe>.json`, served at /payout/<wipe>.json beside status.json. Every row here is one gamepay._check accepts: a 0x wallet (any case), a whole amount >= 1 in game units, a ticker of 1-12 letters and digits, and `for` (optional) the lines a player reads.
